events.name: LA Clippers at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scored a career-high 37 points and dished out six assists in a game Golden State rested stars Stephen Curry and Draymond Green, and the Warriors beat the Los Angeles Clippers 124-112 for their fourth straight win Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Lendeborg scores career-high 37 points, Warriors top Clippers 124-112 without Curry, Green
